result.headline: No control fault shown; roll tracks setpoint with ~1 s lag; start-up battery and sensor warnings unexplained.
result.explanation: Roll follows the setpoint (correlation 0.968 at 0.968 s lag) and the servo outputs move with the setpoint swings. The large steps are manoeuvres or estimator steps, not an actuator fault. The t=0.418 warnings stay unexplained.

evidence.quote: TRACKING control.attitude_setpoint[roll] vs vehicle.attitude[roll]: typical |error| 4.571 deg, worst 42.294 at t=15.968 s; 6 window(s) above 13.712
evidence.shows: Typical roll error is small; the worst error comes during a fast setpoint swing, which fits a lag.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.418 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: Low-voltage warning at start-up; it never repeats. Whether it is real or a start-up transient cannot be told from this data.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.418 s controller.event[mavros: System] mavros: System: ERROR: Sensor helth
evidence.shows: Sensor-health error at the same instant, with no later event. The failing sensor is not identified.

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[1]] at t=15.531 s: 1421 -> 1517 us (step 96, 24x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: ch[1] ramps up shortly after the setpoint swing starts at t=14.68, so the actuator follows the command.

checked.check: Roll setpoint vs roll response, lag-correlated over the whole flight
checked.result: Correlation 0.778 at zero lag, 0.968 at 0.968 s lag. Typical error 4.571 deg, worst 42.294 deg at t=15.968 s.

checked.check: Actuator outputs against setpoint at t=0-4 and t=12-18
checked.result: ch[1..4] move in step with the setpoint swings. Roll peaks at 52.251 deg while the setpoint is held near 44.8 deg, then falls with a delay of about 1 s.
Only two events, both at t=0.418 s. Nothing left baseline in order. The sequence call with a 0-20 s window and zero baseline gave no ordering; a second call without arguments errored.

checked.check: Velocity and yaw steps at t=12-18
checked.result: Velocity x and y change smoothly over several seconds and yaw is continuous (-239.841 to -392.181 deg). The ANOMALY step flags fall on single samples of a continuous turn.

effects.quote: CHANGE vehicle.attitude[roll] at t=15.857 s: 48.044 -> -12.999 deg (step -61.043, 85.6x its usual variation)
effects.why: A response to the setpoint reversal starting at t=14.68, not an independent fault.

effects.quote: CHANGE vehicle.attitude[yaw] at t=13.923 s: -246.383 -> -362.238 deg (step -115.855, 191.7x its usual variation)
effects.why: The yaw angle is unwrapped, so a step here is a turn during the manoeuvre, not a fault.
